pages.text: 1. Find copper and tin veins (Ores & Veins).$(br2)2. Alloy 3 copper + 1 tin into bronze.$(br2)3. Build a Low Pressure Steam Solid Boiler and the first steam machines.$(br2)4. Use the Primitive Blast Furnace for steel, then go LV.
Wrench: right-click a machine to set its facing. Soft Mallet: toggles Up/Down mode on transformers. For any other tool or part, check its recipe in JEI.
The Heracles quest book (key J, or the Quest Book item) walks through the same order chapter by chapter.
